response.original_title: Which are the most popular localities to purchase 4 BHK flats in Ahmedabad?
response.overview: Ahmedabad has several well-developed and growing localities where buyers can find 4 BHK flats for sale. The best area depends on your budget, daily travel, family needs, nearby facilities and future plans for the property. SG Highway, Thaltej, Science City, Bodakdev and Satellite are popular choices for buyers looking for premium homes with good connectivity and access to schools, hospitals, offices, shopping areas and restaurants. Sindhu Bhavan Road and Shilaj are also preferred for spacious and luxury residential properties. For buyers looking for a combination of space, connectivity and value, areas such as Bopal, South Bopal, Shela and Gota are worth considering. Vaishnodevi Circle, Chandkheda and Nava Naroda are other areas where buyers can explore larger residential apartments and new housing projects.  https://www.laxmigroup.co/4-bhk-flats-in-ahmedabad/
